english: Woman, give me seed, I ask you. The mice seized my seed. How many shall I give you? Two bags. I will repay you three bags at harvest time. Give me a pledge. My word is the pledge. Perkunos will hear it. Now take the seed. May the grain grow for you.
uncertain: h1opeye 'make reach; give' read as 'give/hand over'
order of 'gwexn moy sporeh2m h1opeye prskoh2 te' (vocative + imperative + 'I ask you')

english: How shall I sow the seed, mother? Take the seed out of the bag with your right hand and throw it. I threw it, and the birds watch us from the tree. Daughter, don't fear the birds. Let us cover the seed. When will the grain grow? It will grow when the rain-cloud comes. Are you tired? I am not tired. I will sow the whole field.

Sister-in-law, did you hear? It rained in the night. I heard it and rejoiced. The earth drank the rain(-cloud). Now the grain will grow. It will grow, and we will have grain in winter. Are your children healthy? They are healthy. Now my young son walks. May the gods guard him.

Master, the ears are ripening. Shall we cut them today? Let us cut them. Take the knives. The knives are here. Where shall I stand? Stand on the stone, and I will stand here. Who will bind the wheat? My daughters will bind it with ropes. In the evening we will drink. Are your hands strong? They are strong.
uncertain: h2ékes- read as 'ears of grain' (lexicon first sense 'sharpness')

english: Brother, pigs came into the field in the night. Did they eat the young grain? They ate a little and trampled much down. This night we will guard it with the dogs. Do you fear the night? I do not fear. I will carry fire. Pigs fear fire.
uncertain: h1ím (m.) 'it' with grain neuter: perhaps the field

english: Brother, how many bags are full? Ten bags are full. The others are half full. Shall we go hungry in winter? We shall not go hungry. The grain is greater than last year. Did you give our mother grain? I gave her two full bags. She feeds the whole village.
uncertain: sēmi 'half-' and péruti 'last year' not in my form index; read from handbook knowledge
